## Outcome
Link the issue and explain the resulting behavior.

## Scope
Owned paths and exclusions. Identify interface changes and competing writers.

## Evidence
- Starting revision:
- Final reviewed revision:
- Commands and results (pass/fail/not run, with reason):
- Benchmark methodology or sanitized screenshots where applicable:
- Fresh reviewer and unresolved findings:

## Boundaries
Actual permissions and budget used. Any external writes? No secrets, private
machine paths, personal records or chat history in evidence.

## Completion
Which acceptance criteria are satisfied? State remaining blockers explicitly.
CI success is not deployment approval. Source changes after review need re-review.
